<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item that can be crafted at [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. It is very unreliable and often doesn't work on the first (or second) tries, so plan on making more than you think you'll need...

Used on the [[Vampires jaw]].

Note: If struggling with creating the tincture, make sure that you've learnt the recipe by clicking on it in your inventory, then check the second tab of the [[Alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. It cannot be crafted the traditional way, by putting in the 3 ingredients in the slots.

The first time will take all three Memory Tinctures, you will need to buy {{Item|Memory powder}} from [[Clotho]] for {{Money|1000}}.
